lines.lyric_hangul: 이른 아침부터 내겐 너무나 어색한, 음
lines.lyric_translation: Starting early in the morning / I awkwardly mmm

lines.lyric_hangul: 종이와 펜을 꺼내 들어 깊이 삼켜놨던 말을 담아 내
lines.lyric_translation: Take out a pen and a paper / And write down the words I had deeply swallowed

lines.lyric_hangul: 글씨가 예쁘지 못해, 오
lines.lyric_translation: My handwriting isn’t pretty

lines.lyric_hangul: 실망은 말아줘, 조금 서툴러도 눈 감아줘
lines.lyric_translation: Please don’t be disappointed / Please let it go if I suck

lines.lyric_hangul: 이 쪽지에 차곡차곡 너와 내가
lines.lyric_translation: On this letter I want to write down our story

lines.lyric: Uri yaegil sseo naeryeo garyeo hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 우리 얘길 써 내려가려 해
lines.lyric_translation: Every little thing about you and me

lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 날 사랑쪽지에 다 담아서, oh-oh (throw it in the air)
lines.lyric_translation: Write everything down about us on a love letter / (Throw it in the air)

parts.lyric: Neowa nal sarang jjokjie da damaseo

lines.lyric_hangul: 텅 빈 하늘에 올리면 바람도 우릴 감쌀 거야
lines.lyric_translation: And throw it into the empty sky / The wind will embrace us

lines.lyric_hangul: 아팠던 날 들이 지워질 수 있게 널, oh-oh (throw it in the air)
lines.lyric_translation: So that your painful days of the past are erased / (Throw it in the air)

parts.lyric: Apatteon naldeuri jiweojil su itge neol

lines.lyric_hangul: 널 꽉 안아 놓지 않을게, 늘 네 옆에 있어줄게
lines.lyric_translation: I will hold you tighly and never let go / I will always be by your side

lines.lyric_hangul: One, two, three
표현만큼 서툰 삐뚤삐뚤한 글씨가
lines.lyric_translation: Worrying all night about my bad handwriting

lines.lyric: Geokjeongdwae bamsae gominhae sseun nae mameul garilkka
lines.lyric_hangul: 걱정돼, 밤새 고민해 쓴 내 맘을 가릴까?
lines.lyric_translation: Which is about as bad as how I express my feelings

lines.lyric: Jeongseongkkeot pyohyeonhae bwado pyohyeoni an dwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 정성껏 표현 해봐도 표현이 안돼
lines.lyric_translation: I try to sincerely express myself but I can’t get it out

lines.lyric_hangul: 밤새 머리를 꽁꽁 싸매도 내 맘을 못 전해 (ooh)
lines.lyric_translation: I try to wrap my head around this all night / But I can’t deliver my feelings

lines.lyric: Neon ireon gominhaneun nae mameul alkka?
lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 이런 고민하는 내 맘을 알까?
lines.lyric_translation: I wonder if you know how much I’m worrying

lines.lyric_hangul: 주머니 속에 쪽지는 언제 전할까? (언제 전할까?)
lines.lyric_translation: When do I give you the letter in my pocket?

lines.lyric_hangul: 무작정 다가가, 네 앞에 서서 괜히, 숨을 가다듬어
lines.lyric_translation: I approach you without thinking / And calm my breath

parts.lyric: Ni ape seoseo gwaenhi sumeul gadadeumeo

lines.lyric_hangul: 손 좀 내밀어줄래? 자, 이거
lines.lyric_translation: “Can you give me your hand? / Here, this is for you”

lines.lyric_hangul: 이 쪽지에 차곡차곡 너와 내가
lines.lyric_translation: On this letter I want to write down our story

lines.lyric: Uri yaegil sseo naeryeo garyeo hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 우리 얘길 써 내려가려 해, ooh-whoa, baby
lines.lyric_translation: Every little thing about you and me

lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 날 사랑쪽지에 다 담아서, oh-oh (throw it in the air)
lines.lyric_translation: Write everything down about us on a love letter / (Throw it in the air)

lines.lyric_hangul: 텅 빈 하늘에 올리면 바람도 우릴 감쌀 거야
lines.lyric_translation: And throw it into the empty sky / The wind will embrace us

lines.lyric_translation: So that your painful days of the past are erased / (Throw it in the air)

lines.lyric_hangul: 널 꽉 안아 놓지 않을게, 늘 네 옆에 있어줄게
lines.lyric_translation: I will hold you tighly and never let go / I will always be by your side

lines.lyric_hangul: 난 아직까지도 (oh-oh) 너에게 끝내 하지 못했던
lines.lyric_translation: There are still / So many things

lines.lyric_hangul: 그 많았던 말들이 남았지만
lines.lyric_translation: I ended up not able to tell you

lines.lyric_hangul: 두 팔을 크게 벌려, 저 하늘을 걸고서 맹세해
lines.lyric_translation: I open my arms / And swear to the sky

lines.lyric_hangul: 널 두고 도망가지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: I won’t leave you and run away

lines.lyric: Neowa nal sarang jjokjie da damaseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 날 사랑쪽지에 다 담아서, 음
lines.lyric_translation: Write everything down about us on a love letter

lines.lyric_hangul: 저 하늘에 올리면
lines.lyric_translation: Mmm and raise it in that sky

lines.lyric_hangul: You know it can't get any better than this, babe
lines.lyric_translation: You know I can’t get / Any better than this babe

lines.lyric_hangul: Oh-oh, yeah

lines.lyric_hangul: 아팠던 날들이 지워질 수 있게 널, oh-oh (oh)
